QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: guidedMinimumAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Minimum altitude for guided actions altitude slider.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: guidedMaximumAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum altitude for guided actions altitude slider.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showAdditionalIndicatorsCompass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show additional heading indicators on Compass

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showSimpleCameraControl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, the camera control panel with photo/video capture buttons is shown in the fly view.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showPhotoCaptureIndicators
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, a small camera icon is drawn on the map at each photo capture location. Disable to improve performance on large photogrammetry missions.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showMissionOnMap
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Master switch for displaying the mission on the Fly View map (polyline, waypoint markers, and direction arrows). Turn off to hide all mission visuals without losing the loaded mission.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: missionWaypointDisplay
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Mission waypoint markers on Fly View
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Controls visibility of numbered waypoint markers on the Fly View map. The mission path line is always drawn. Hiding markers improves performance on large photogrammetry missions.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: autoLoadMissionOnConnect
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, QGC requests the mission from the vehicle on every connection. Disable to avoid slow mission downloads; you can still trigger a manual download from the Quick Config panel.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showObstacleDistanceOverlay
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show obstacle distance overlay on map and video.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: maxGoToLocationDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum distance allowed for Go To Location.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: forwardFlightGoToLocationLoiterRad
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Loiter radius for orbiting the Go To Location during forward flight. This only applies if the firmware supports a radius in MAV_CMD_DO_REPOSITION commands.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: goToLocationRequiresConfirmInGuided
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Require slide confirmation for Go To Location when the vehicle is already in Guided mode.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: updateHomePosition
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Send updated GCS' home position to autopilot in case of change of the home position

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: instrumentQmlFile2
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Integrated Compass & Attitude,Horizontal Compass & Attitude,Large Vertical

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requestControlAllowTakeover
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: When requesting vehicle control, allow other GCS to override control automatically, or require this GCS to accept the request first.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requestControlTimeout
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Timeout in seconds before a request to a GCS to allow takeover is assumed to be rejected. This is used to display the timeout graphically on requestor and GCS in control.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showForwardRangefinder
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, the forward rangefinder indicator will be shown in the fly view toolbar.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showDownRangefinder
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, the downward rangefinder indicator will be shown in the fly view toolbar.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rangefinderRCChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: RC channel for down rangefinder enable/disable
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: X55 only. RC channel used to drive the down rangefinder active-state dot. When the channel value is above 1500, the indicator is shown as active. Set to 0 to disable RC channel monitoring. Ignored on Xplorer, which uses firmware-broadcast RFND_ST instead.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: forwardRangefinderRCChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: RC channel for forward rangefinder enable/disable
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: X55 only. RC channel used to drive the forward rangefinder active-state dot. When the channel value is above 1500, the indicator is shown as active. Set to 0 to disable RC channel monitoring. Ignored on Xplorer, which uses firmware-broadcast FWD_ST instead.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showPayloadIndicator
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, the payload indicator with geotagging status and payload selection is shown in the toolbar.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: payloadSerialPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Which ArduPilot serial port the payload is connected to. Used to check SERIALx_BAUD for payload detection.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: payloadIlxBaud
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The SERIALx_BAUD parameter value that indicates an ILX-LR1 payload is configured. 921 = 921600 baud.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: payloadVioBaud
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The SERIALx_BAUD parameter value that indicates a VIO payload is configured.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: payloadMavlinkCamType
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: CAM1_TYPE value written when selecting the generic MAVLink Camera payload. 5=MAVLink, 6=MAVLinkCamV2.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: payloadMavlinkCamBaud
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Generic MAVLink camera baud rate parameter value
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The SERIALx_BAUD parameter value written for a generic MAVLink camera payload (e.g. Sentera 65R).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tapToFocusEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Enable tap-to-focus on the payload video
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, tapping the ILX payload video feed sends the tapped point to the TAG-E as an autofocus point (DO_DIGICAM_CONFIGURE p1=1101) and triggers autofocus (p1=135).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tapToFocusSpotMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Flexible Spot size used for tap-to-focus
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Sony AF area mode applied (DO_DIGICAM_CONFIGURE p1=180, p7=mode) when tap-to-focus is enabled. 262=Spot XS, 257=S, 258=M, 259=L, 263=XL. When tap-to-focus is disabled, Wide (1) is applied.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enableMicROM
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, the MicROM UV camera controller and toolbar indicator will be available. Requires app restart.
